newsitem.title: UK: Ban "Nazi festival" in Britain - MEP Kinnock.
newsitem.headline: Ban "Nazi festival" in Britain - MEP Kinnock.

text.p: European member of parliament Glenys Kinnock called on Britain on Thursday to ban an "Aryan Music Festival" expected to attract hundreds of fascists from Europe and North America.
"It is an appalling idea and must be stopped," said Kinnock in a statement over the proposed festival in the Welsh city of Cardiff in August.
Kinnock, whose husband Neil is the European Union's Transport Commissioner, said: "In Wales, we reject the messages of hate and prejudice which the Nazis peddle."
"I call upon the police and the (local) council to use legal powers which they have to stop this event now," she said in a statement.
